description: Request a stay from a quote. Set house_rules_accepted only after the guest has seen and agreed to the quote's house_rules. If the quote's payment.collected_by is "threshold", the booking starts as awaiting_payment and the response includes payment_url: the guest must open payment_url and add a card within 60 minutes, after which the host gets the request (status pending_host_confirmation). Otherwise the request goes to the host immediately and the host arranges payment after accepting. Returns the booking and a status link to give the guest; poll get_booking for changes.

email.description: The guest's email: confirmations, the payment link and the host's messages go there.

house_rules_accepted.description: True only after the guest has seen and agreed to the quote's house_rules.

phone.description: The guest's phone number in international format, e.g. +15551234567. Optional.

quote_id.description: The quote being booked, from get_quote (starts with quo_).

special_requests.description: Anything the guest wants the host to know, in their words (arrival time, a question). Optional, up to 500 characters.

name: request_booking

status.description: e.g. awaiting_payment, pending_host_confirmation, confirmed, declined, cancelled.

total.description: An amount in cents with its currency.

payment_url.description: When present, the guest opens this to add a card; the request reaches the host only after that.

title: Request to book
